title: Per-project GitHub SSH identities
summary: Git reads preserve the remote URL and SSH alias; read-only clone/fetch/fast-forward pull have a straightforward path; staging, committing and non-force pushing are preview-confirm operations.
invariants: Do not rewrite remotes, IdentityFile or ~/.ssh/config to force a result.
Inspect repo root, alias, effective SSH configuration, branch, staged set and exact argv before writes.
Do not silently stage all files or force push.
